title: Item 4 · Fixing a payment — undo and edit
subtitle: A mix. Star and Black Belt ask first before undoing a payment — approved (Star v0.508; Black Belt v0.912, because the database refuses to undo an undo, so an undone payment can't be brought back). Color Belt and Camps undo at once with no question and no Undo — nobody decided that (drift), and it breaks rule 1.4 either way. After Edit payment, only Black Belt offers Undo. footer:
Your choice — one question:
A · Keep as today. + no work. − the same admin action behaves two ways; Color Belt and Camps undo money with neither a question nor an Undo (nobody chose this; rule 1.4 asks for one or the other).
B · Recommended: one rule everywhere, copied from Star and Black Belt. Undo payment always asks first (it can't be brought back — rule 1.4: not reversible → confirm), and Edit payment always ends with “Payment changed” + Undo (rule 1.4: edit → Undo). + the same everywhere, follows the rulebook, reuses approved designs. − one more tap when an admin undoes a payment in Color Belt or Camps.
C · The other way round: undo at once everywhere, and let the toast's Undo record the payment again. + fastest. − you rejected exactly this for Black Belt (v0.912): it adds extra lines and moves the payment's date to today on the Daily report; Star and Black Belt would lose the question you approved.
